name: save-boot-14a-item-screen-open
description: #135 (diagnostic, attempt 2): what the menu's overlay bookkeeping and the Item screen's hypothesised variables read after Item is chosen. Load harness/saves/disc1-md1stin-potion.json, open the field menu (as save-boot-10b) and wait 60 frames, check the main-menu cursor is on row 0 (Item), press Circle once, wait 300 frames with no checks, then report the raw menu_ovl (expected 1), menu_prev, ovl_addr (expected 0x801D0000), item_screen (expected 1), list_row (expected 0), row0 and game_state. Checks: menu_ovl 1, item_screen 1, still in the menu.

game_state.description: g_GameState (s16 as u16; confirmed #76): field 1, menu 5.

map_cur.description: g_FieldCurrentMap (s16 as u16; confirmed #77): the field ID.

loading.description: g_IsFieldLoading (s16 as u16; confirmed #77): 2 in a settled field.

row0.description: menuCursor (confirmed #78): the main-menu cursor, row 0 = Item.

item_screen.description: itemMenuScreen (hypothesis, #135): g_ItemMenuCurrentScreen, an Item-menu overlay variable: 1 the item list, 2 picking a party member. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@33ce78c (reference only, no code) config/symbols.itemmenu.us.txt, src/menu/itemmenu.c

list_row.description: itemListRow (hypothesis, #135): g_ItemMenuWidgets[1] (0x801D3DDC + 0x12) + 0x0B row, the item list cursor on the page. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@33ce78c (reference only, no code) include/game.h MenuTable

list_off.description: itemListOffset (hypothesis, #135): g_ItemMenuWidgets[1] + 0x02 rowOffset, the slot on the top row. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@33ce78c (reference only, no code)

party_row.description: itemTargetSlot (hypothesis, #135): g_ItemMenuWidgets[2] (0x801D3DDC + 0x24) + 0x0B row, the party cursor. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@33ce78c (reference only, no code)

menu_ovl.description: D_80062DD4 (hypothesis, #135 attempt 2): the menu overlay id SysMenuLoadMenuFileById last asked for; 1 = the Item screen (ITEMMENU_Init is entry 1 of the init table D_800493A8). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@33ce78c (reference only, no code) src/main/1F6B4.c, src/main/ovl.c

menu_prev.description: D_80062DD0 (hypothesis): the overlay id before it. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@33ce78c (reference only, no code) src/main/1F6B4.c

ovl_addr.description: D_80062DEC (hypothesis): the RAM address menu overlays are read to (0x801D0000 initially; a setter can change it). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@33ce78c (reference only, no code) src/main/1F6B4.c LoadMenuOvl

hp1.description: partyHp1 (confirmed #101): g_ActiveCharacters[1].hp, the slot the item is used on.
